name: vanta
description: Open source AI video engine built on Remotion. Voice cloning, AI avatars, animated captions, text-to-video, AI music, video editor, timeline, 100+ transitions. Free Synthesia / HeyGen / Runway / CapCut / Descript alternative. 40+ repos, one render pipeline, $0.

scripts.build: npx remotion render src/index.ts VantaShowcase out/vanta-showcase.mp4
scripts.render: npx remotion render src/index.ts VantaShowcase out/vanta-showcase.mp4
scripts.render:gif: npx remotion render src/index.ts VantaShowcase out/vanta-showcase.gif --image-format png
scripts.render:voiceover: npx remotion render src/index.ts VoiceoverDemo out/voiceover-demo.mp4
scripts.render:avatar: npx remotion render src/index.ts AvatarDemo out/avatar-demo.mp4
scripts.render:captions: npx remotion render src/index.ts CaptionsDemo out/captions-demo.mp4
scripts.render:video: npx remotion render src/index.ts AiVideoDemo out/ai-video-demo.mp4
scripts.render:music: npx remotion render src/index.ts MusicDemo out/music-demo.mp4
scripts.render:cutout: npx remotion render src/index.ts BgRemoveDemo out/cutout-demo.mp4
scripts.render:editor: npx remotion render src/index.ts EditorDemo out/editor-demo.mp4
scripts.render:timeline: npx remotion render src/index.ts TimelineDemo out/timeline-demo.mp4
scripts.render:transitions: npx remotion render src/index.ts TransitionsDemo out/transitions-demo.mp4
scripts.render:motion: npx remotion render src/index.ts MotionGraphicsDemo out/motion-graphics-demo.mp4
